c74object.name: evi.trigholdgate~
c74object.digest: Trigger audio rate gates held for X ms in length
c74object.description:
evi.trigholdgate~ is a 'max define' for the evi_trigholdgate.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.trigholdgate~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does.
Audio rate trigger gates held for specified time, responding to trigger up, down or up/down, hold specified in ms including zero ms for single sample click.

inlet.description: Any audio rate trigger upwards or downwards can be detected depending on @trigger attribute.

outlet.description: Triggered gate of length specified by @hold attribute.

attribute.name: hold
attribute.description: Amount of time (set in ms) to 'hold' the (rectangular) triggered on/off gate for. zero = 1-sample click.

attribute.name: trigger
attribute.description: Respond to input trigger type: 0 = up/down, 1 = up only (default), 2 = down only.

c74object.discussion: Works particularly well for triggering evi.vactrol~.
